name: Arlington
living: the big white-and-blue star on the roof truss catches a slow glint that travels across its points
the Texas flag on the right light tower ripples in the evening breeze
the flat orange horizon glows and slowly cools toward violet as the sunset fades
small sunset clouds drift slowly through the gap under the roof (sky layer drift)
the cowboy-hat video board tips its hat after a home run
the concourse ribbon lights along each deck twinkle and chase slowly
light-tower lamp banks glow and softly pulse, dust and moths drifting through the cones
downtown windows flicker on one by one under the roof's shadow
crowd shimmer across the tiered stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
